thread:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — finalizing spot awards batch for Q2. Need approvals + payroll cutoff dates. Nominations close Fri EOD. Approvals Mon. Payroll cutoff Tue 9:00am PT. Finance, can you confirm the timing?

Jonah (Finance): We can hit Tue 9am if we get the final list by Mon 2pm for budget validation. Also need to confirm tax handling (gross vs net) — are these processed as income?

Alex (Payroll): We process as supplemental pay (taxable). CSV required with employee_id, amount, cost_center. Deadline for files on our side is Mon 3pm to be safe. Changes after that will miss this run.

Priya (HRIS): I can do the export. What template do you need? Any extra fields like manager email or department code?

Maya (People Ops): Use this template link: https://redwood-internal/hr/spot-award-template.csv — required columns: employee_email,employee_id,amount_usd,approver_email,award_reason (one-line). Example header:
```
employee_email,employee_id,amount_usd,approver_email,award_reason
```
Include cost_center if available, otherwise Priya will default to People Ops.

spot-awards-bot: Nomination portal is open — 18 nominations so far, 3 slots left for this batch. :tada:

Jonah (Finance): Budget check: we have ~$12,000 remaining in the Q2 recognition pool. If any single award > $1,000 we need VP sign-off. Priya, can you tag cost_center so we can attribute spend?

Priya (HRIS): Yep — I will add cost_center and manager_id columns in the export. Will run a preview Fri 10am and drop it in the secure folder.

Maya (People Ops): Reminder: awards > $1,000 require VP approval. Looping in @Nora for that case. Also please keep award_reason concise — helps approvals move faster.

Nora (VP People): Thanks for the heads up — I can review Monday morning. If you send the shortlist with reasons, I'll prioritize it.

Alex (Payroll): :thumbsup: I'll queue the payroll job for Tue 9:00am PT. Final CSV needs to be placed at /secure/hr/payments/spot_awards.csv and encrypted. Any last-minute adjustments will need a signed change request.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Folks submit nominations by Fri EOD. 2) Priya to share preview Fri 10am. 3) Approvers review Mon by 2pm. 4) HR/Payroll final csv in secure folder Mon by 3pm. 5) Payroll run Tue 9am PT. I'll post a checklist and a quick reminder on Thurs.

Priya (HRIS): Sharing preview via DM now.

Jonah (Finance): Confirmed budget and timeline from finance side. Will fast-track any >$1k approvals once Nora signs off.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — saving this thread as the coordination source. Ping here if timeline slips or if we hit a nomination surge. :seedling:
